[seafades] Deal in $ value? yes! (But $10k?, read on)
Few things at play here, majorly AUD/INR Forex(Business is operating from India).
The current AX7 is $29,990 drive-away, vs $35,990 in January - a $6k headline drop.
But AUD/INR has moved from ~₹60 to ~₹68, so in INR terms:
Jan: ₹2,159k -> Now: ₹2,039k
So the FX-adjusted saving is only around $1.8k AUD, rather than the full $6k.($10k headline saving is somewhat exaggerated, factoring new model has launched)
Still a good deal at $29,990 drive-away , but the headline $ saving claim is making it look like bigger savings.
EDIT: Apologies, I couldn’t understand the ₹ in Lakh(as they use in India)
